title: The Teachings of Jesus
subtitle: What Jesus taught, by subject, across the four Gospels, with the roots and the echoes of each saying
summary: "No one ever spoke like this man" (John 7:46). This study gathers what Jesus taught about Himself, the kingdom, discipleship, love and forgiveness, prayer and faith, money, the Spirit and the Word, and the end. Every saying is in His own words, so every reference weighs three; zoom into one to see the Scripture it grows from, where He said it again, and how the apostles carried it on.
